review_candidates.title: Mpd Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description The company is a growing organization seeking to strengthen its engineering capabilities in Cairo, Egypt. It focuses on delivering reliable, high-quality products and solutions, with an emphasis on innovation, safety, and continuous improvement. Team members collaborate across disciplines to solve complex technical challenges and support efficient operations. The work environment encourages professional development, knowledge sharing, and accountability. Candidates joining the company can expect to contribute to impactful projects and gain exposure to modern engineering practices. Role Description The MPD Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, Egypt, responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing Managed Pressure Drilling operations. Day-to-day tasks include preparing engineering designs and programs, performing technical calculations, and ensuring MPD equipment is properly selected, installed, tested, and maintained. The MPD Engineer monitors operations in real time, analyzes drilling data, and recommends adjustments to maintain well control, improve drilling performance, and reduce operational risks. The role involves collaborating closely with drilling, subsurface, and HSE teams, participating in pre-job meetings and post-job reviews, and preparing clear technical reports and documentation. The MPD Engineer also supports training, implementation of best practices, and adherence to all relevant safety and regulatory standards. Qualifications Strong foundation in drilling engineering or petroleum engineering, with applied knowledge of well control, hydraulics, and drilling fluids. Experience or training in Managed Pressure Drilling (MPD) operations, including system components, control methods, and operational procedures. Ability to interpret well schematics, drilling programs, and technical drawings, and to perform relevant engineering calculations accurately. Proficiency in using industry-standard engineering and data analysis software for drilling design, modeling, and performance evaluation. Effective communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to coordinate with multidisciplinary teams and present technical findings clearly. Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, particularly under operational pressure and in dynamic field conditions. Commitment to safety, risk management, and compliance with company policies, industry standards, and local regulations. Bachelor’s degree in Petroleum Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline; prior experience in drilling or well engineering is an advantage. Willingness to work on-site, occasionally in field environments, and to adapt to changing operational requirements.

review_candidates.title: Office Manager
review_candidates.description: Company Description MetalChem Eg. (MetalChem/MetalTech) specializes in chemical surface treatment solutions for industrial applications. The company focuses on enhancing the durability, performance, and appearance of metal components through advanced treatment processes. MetalChem Eg. collaborates with a range of manufacturing and engineering clients, providing reliable, high-quality services tailored to specific technical requirements. The organization values safety, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement, offering team members a structured environment to grow their skills. Joining MetalChem Eg. means contributing to a technical field that supports key industrial sectors. Role Description The Office Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in New Cairo. This role oversees daily office operations, including managing administrative tasks, coordinating schedules, organizing documents, and maintaining office records. The Office Manager will handle incoming calls and correspondence, support customer inquiries, and ensure visitors and clients receive professional assistance. Responsibilities include managing office supplies and equipment, coordinating with vendors and service providers, and supporting internal communication between departments. The role also involves preparing reports, assisting with basic financial and HR-related documentation, and implementing office policies to maintain an efficient, well-organized workplace. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Communication and Customer Service skills to interact effectively with colleagues, clients, and vendors. Candidates should possess Office Administration and Administrative Assistance skills to manage records, schedules, and day-to-day office workflows. Candidates should possess practical experience with Office Equipment and basic office software (e.g., email, word processing, spreadsheets). Candidates should possess strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize multiple tasks. Relevant experience as an Office Manager or in a similar administrative role is preferred. A diploma or bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, or a related field is beneficial. Ability to work on-site in New Cairo and collaborate with cross-functional teams in an industrial environment.

Deloitte innovation hub (DIH) is a strategic initiative established to support our ambition to become the leading business transformation partner of choice for our clients and to expand and scale our delivery footprint across EMEA. With access to a scaled, diverse, highly skilled, motivated, and engaged workforce, DIH is delivering complex technical solutions for clients’ most complex business problems, across portfolios that include ‘Strategy & Transactions’, ‘Customer’, ‘Engineering, AI & Data, ‘Enterprise, Technology & Performance’ and ‘Cyber’. DIH is aiming to become the destination for top talents in Egypt for a long, exciting career. We invest in outstanding people of diverse talents and backgrounds and empower them to achieve more than they could elsewhere. Our work combines advice with action and integrity. We believe that when our clients and society are stronger, so are we. Our organization has grown in scale and diversity, providing services across the region, with our shared culture remaining the same. We aim to help clients realize their ambitions, make a positive difference in society, and maximize the success of our people. This drive fuels the commitment and humanity that run deep through our every action. Connect to your opportunity Our consultants work in a variety of projects to solve clients' toughest data problems by combining industry experience, consulting, and analytical skills to create a lasting impact. Responsibilities Our projects and clients vary greatly, and your responsibilities will differ based on your level of experience/skillset and the focus of the client engagement, but within our Analytics & Cognitive SAS practice, your role is likely to include some or all the following: Advising clients on appropriate tooling for a particular solution based on your expertise in specific technologies Supporting our future pipeline of work, from design to sales, through to setup and delivery Placing a focus upon exceeding client expectations and delivering against our continuous improvement goals, taking on a client problem, and turning it into a technical solution Providing technical oversight for other team members, including mentoring and guidance on technologies and methodologies Having the opportunity to lead and directly shape client relationships, with extensive client interaction as part of our Analytics team Working in an environment where self-development, learning and knowledge sharing is actively encouraged as part of the day-to-day work of the team Connect To Your Skills And Professional Experience Bachelor's degree in computer science or computer engineering from reputable university 3-6 years of experience as Software Testing Engineer at least 2 of them in Testing Automation using Java. 2+ years of programming experience, preferably in Java. Experience in Test Management tools (Jira) Experience in API Testing Automation tools (SOAPUI, Postman) Experience in Test Automation tools and frameworks (Selenium, Cucumber, Rest Assured, Playwright would be a plus) Participate in internal and client-facing meetings to discuss requirements and shape test scripts based on knowledge of the product. Identify and breakdown the necessary tasks to test a new product Design test scripts by working with stakeholders and other members of the team Set up automated tests and UAT test scripts Identify and carry out a root cause analysis of errors and flag issues as and when they surface Participating in some of the offering development process to understand the growth and capability of the product Adhering to and updating established QA processes Devising and deploying fixes and improvements Writing and updating user documentation and operational procedures Visualize the test script results either by developing reports independently or working with the visualization developers. Using the knowledge of product testing to work in developing any in-built product validation processes where required Connect to your service line - Consulting Distinctive thinking, deep expertise, and collaborative working. That’s what connects us. That’s what makes us Deloitte. If you want to help solve some of the biggest challenges around, join us. Together, we’ll make an impact that matters. Personal independence Regulation and controls are standard practice in our industry and Deloitte is no exception. These controls provide important legal protection for both you and the firm. We are subject to a number of audit regulations, one of which requires that certain colleagues abide by specific personal independence constraints. This can mean that you and your "Immediate Family Members" are not permitted to hold certain financial interests (shares, funds, bonds etc.) with audit clients of the firm. The recruitment team will provide further details as you progress through the recruitment process. Connect to your Industry “What attracted me to Deloitte were the endless opportunities and the collective experience of other like-minded individuals. Deloitte’s clients include many of the world’s largest organizations; I wanted to be part of a team that made a difference that I could be proud of.” Dan, Technology and Transformation Our commitment to you Making an impact is more than just what we do: it’s why we’re here. So we work hard to create an environment where you can experience a purpose you believe in, the freedom to be you, and the capacity to go further than ever before. We want you. The true you. Your own strengths, perspective and personality. So we’re nurturing a culture where everyone belongs, feels supported and heard, and is empowered to make a valuable, personal contribution. You can be sure we’ll take your wellbeing seriously, too. Because it’s only when you’re comfortable and at your best that you can make the kind of impact you, and we, live for. Your expertise is our capability, so we’ll make sure it never stops growing. Whether it’s from the complex work you do, or the people you collaborate with, you’ll learn every day. Through world-class development, you’ll gain invaluable technical and personal skills. Whatever your level, you’ll learn how to lead. Connect to your next step A career at Deloitte is an opportunity to develop in any direction you choose. Join us and you’ll experience a purpose you can believe in and an impact you can see. You’ll be free to bring your true self to work every day. And you’ll never stop growing, whatever your level.
